title: Forgotten Fairy Tales
description: Interesting tehno-magical mod which can be a base for assembly of mods and itself has got a big history
body:
FFT or Forgotten Fairy Tales - a techo-magical mod with class system and unusual mechanics. This mod adds a lot of different structures. There you can find unusual vase with help of which you can become one of three classes: The great warrior, the powerful mage and the genius engineer. All this classes radically change the gameplay.

Description of classes:

The great hero - You'll become a successful army leader and master of military art.

The powerful mage - You'll get the magic that you're father can only dream of.

The genius engineer - You'll become the smartest person with endless knowledge.
